summary: Iteration 14 validated (a) Twilio WhatsApp company alerts in DEMO mode with gating/triggers/dedupe, (b) PUT edit endpoints for seeker & provider incl. ownership + boosted-flag preservation, and (c) referral self-signup gate + 2-signup auto-unlock regression. 10/10 backend tests pass; frontend Edit + CompanyAlerts flows verified end-to-end on the live preview URL.

backend.unlock_cv_generates_alert_trigger_B: kind=matching_crew, status=simulated, mode=demo, to starts with '+', message='A new matching Chief Engineer is available on Smart Crewing.'
backend.get_noticed_pay_notifies_paying_companie: matching paying company receives exactly 1 alert for the boosted seeker
backend.dedupe_per_company_seeker: re-boost + re-post matching requirement yields exactly 1 wa_alerts row
backend.put_seeker_profile_updates_and_preserves: sending boosted=false is ignored; other fields persist; returned doc has boosted=true
backend.ownership_enforcement_404: seeker & provider edit by non-owner returns 404
backend.referral_self_ref_not_counted: verify-otp with own ref_code -> ref_signups stays 0

frontend.provider_dashboard_matches_company_wa_al: visible with DEMO badge and the exact alert message
frontend.my_posts_edit_button_present: data-testid edit-post-btn-<id> rendered for provider & seeker cards
frontend.edit_dialog_prefill_and_save: opens data-testid=edit-post-dialog, fields pre-filled, edit-save-btn persists change (visible after full page reload)
frontend.seeker_edit_preserves_boosted_badge: after saving edited name, reload shows updated name AND BOOSTED badge still present

critical_code_review_comments: notify_company_of_boosted_matches after PUT /provider/requirement/{id} loops through ALL currently-boosted matching seekers each time a requirement is edited. Dedupe on (company, seeker) prevents duplicate rows, but on the very first company post/unlock a company can receive many alerts in one shot (as observed: 12 rows for one paying company against a dev DB with many boosted seekers). This is intended by design but flag if UX volume becomes a concern in production.

EditPostDialog.jsx save() sends consent=true unconditionally — correct given the model requires it, but note the mobile field is disabled in UI yet still submitted; if mobile ever changed in DB out-of-band, this would overwrite it back to the original.

PUT /seeker/profile also triggers notify_companies_of_seeker whenever doc.boosted is true — combined with the boosted preservation and dedupe this is safe, but every edit re-scans providers. Consider only firing when rank/vessel_type/sea_time/coc actually changed.
server.py is 1592 lines — well above the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting into routers (auth, seeker, provider, matches, alerts, referral).
test_credentials: OTP always 123456. Tests create fresh +91XXXXXXXXXX accounts via /api/auth/request-otp + verify-otp per case.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests and the Playwright run each create fresh seeker+provider pairs, then boost + unlock to produce demo wa_alerts rows. No cleanup performed (mobile_key collisions negligible; assertions filter by seeker_id).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 14 features (WA alerts DEMO mode, edit endpoints, referral gate) all green. Reusable regression test: /app/backend/tests/test_wa_alerts_and_edit.py. Note wa_alerts collection accumulates across runs in dev DB — assertions must filter by seeker_id, not rely on total count. When testing CompanyAlerts UI, seed via API (POST get-noticed/pay then POST unlock-cv) and inject token into localStorage['mc_token'] to bypass the chat signup flow.
